Q: How can I safely delete vscode-server-stable-linux-x64.tar.gz from my system? A:

Can I safely delete the vscode-server-stable-linux-x64.tar.gz file

Yes.

Your WSL environment (programs such as /usr/bin/true) was populated with a command like "tar zxvf vscode-server-stable-linux-x64.tar.gz". So now the .tgz is redundant with those expanded files which landed in places like /usr/bin/; it's fine to delete it. You can always re-download it again if you feel the need.

Of course an auto-updater might download a revised copy in future. If you lack available disk space for that it could lead to some inconvenience; consider finding additional ways to cleanup unused files. You may want to explore adding SSD or even thumb-drive storage.

Q: How can I select the item that doesn't have attribute A: 
*:not([title])

This will select everything that does not have attribute title.

See this JSFiddle for an example.

Q: How do I select a CSS element that has no attributes? A:

This is known in shdcn's select components. Not only in Button. Reason for this is shadcn's SelectTrigger wrapper unconditionally renders chevron icon alongside whatever children you pass.

When you pass asChild to SelectTrigger that prop gets spread onto the underlying Redix SelectPrimitive.Trigger . AsChild (Redix's) uses slot internally which requires exactly one child element through React. Children.only . But here it receiving two , Button and handcoded chevron icon and it throw regardless of the element type you swap in. That's why switching from dev to button didn't work for you.
You can fix it by bypassing shadcn's SelectTrigger wrapper and use the raw Redix primitive directly, since it wont inject that extra icon.
